def _inputs(split, x, calibration, dt, critical, bands):
    gain, bias = calibration[split['lab_id']].T
    past = gain[:, None] * split['past_stress_cmd'] + bias[:, None]
    hold = gain * split['stress_hold_cmd'] + bias
    damage = np.maximum(np.abs(past) - critical, 0.0) ** 2 @ dt
    active = (bands <= 0.5) & (damage > 0.0)
    activation = np.where(active, np.tanh(damage), 0.0)
    return (past, hold, np.column_stack((np.ones(len(x)), x)), activation, active)

reusable_ast_function_closures.code:
def _design(tau, dt, t, past, hold, flow, activation, _active):
    response = -np.expm1(-dt[:, None] / tau)
    decay = np.exp(-dt[:, None] / tau)
    z = np.zeros((len(hold), 2))
    for stress, a, b in zip(past.T, decay, response):
        z = a * z + b * stress[:, None]
    gap = hold[:, None] - z
    growth = -np.expm1(-t[:, None] / tau)
    plateau = np.log1p(t)
    mode0 = activation * hold
    mode1 = activation * z[:, 0]
    a = np.empty((len(hold), len(t), 9))
    a[:, :, :2] = gap[:, None, :] * growth
    a[:, :, 2:7] = flow[:, None, :] * plateau[None, :, None]
    a[:, :, 7] = mode0[:, None] * growth[:, 0]
    a[:, :, 8] = mode1[:, None] * plateau
    b = np.column_stack((gap / tau, flow, mode0 / tau[0], mode1))
    return (a, b)

def _refine_calibration(dataset, cal, sparse, x, strains, rates):
    from scipy.optimize import least_squares
    train = dataset['train']
    labs = train['lab_id']
    complete = np.isfinite(train['coupon_features_raw']).all(axis=1)
    anchor = complete & ~np.isin(labs, list(sparse))
    if not np.any(anchor):
        return
    args = _inputs(dataset, train, cal, x)
    p = _fit(_take_inputs(args, anchor), strains[anchor], rates[anchor])
    c, r, *_ = _design(p[:2], *_take_inputs(args, anchor))
    curve_scale = np.array([_mad(v) for v in (c @ p[2:] - strains[anchor]).T])
    rate_scale = _mad(r @ p[2:] - rates[anchor])
    for lab, (cmd, true) in sparse.items():
        mask = complete & (labs == lab)
        if not np.any(mask):
            continue
        local = {k: train[k][mask] for k in ('lab_id', 'past_stress_cmd', 'stress_hold_cmd')}
        if 'shear_banding_index' in train:
            local['shear_banding_index'] = np.broadcast_to(train['shear_banding_index'], labs.shape)[mask]
        elif np.ndim(dataset.get('shear_banding_index', 0.0)):
            local['shear_banding_index'] = np.asarray(dataset['shear_banding_index'])[mask]
        pivot = cmd.mean() if len(cmd) else 0.0
        target = true.mean() if len(cmd) else 0.0

        def coefficients(q):
            return (q[0], target - pivot * q[0] if len(cmd) == 1 else q[1])

        def residual(q):
            cal[lab] = coefficients(q)
            c, r, *_ = _design(p[:2], *_inputs(dataset, local, cal, x[mask]))
            return np.r_[((c @ p[2:] - strains[mask]) / curve_scale).ravel(), (r @ p[2:] - rates[mask]) / rate_scale]
        q0 = cal[lab, :1 if len(cmd) == 1 else 2].copy()
        lower = [1e-05] if len(q0) == 1 else [1e-05, -np.inf]
        fit = least_squares(residual, q0, bounds=(lower, np.inf), loss='soft_l1', max_nfev=120)
        cal[lab] = coefficients(fit.x)

def _refine_short_pairs(data, calibration, features, dt, times):
    """Constrain an unresolved two-point slope using in-batch rheology."""
    from scipy.optimize import least_squares
    cal = data['calibration_load_cells']
    labs, cmd, true = map(np.asarray, (cal['lab_id'], cal['cmd_stress'], cal['true_stress']))
    pairs = {}
    for lab in range(4):
        take = (labs == lab) & np.isfinite(cmd) & np.isfinite(true)
        if take.sum() == 2 and np.ptp(cmd[take]) < 0.03:
            pairs[lab] = (cmd[take].mean(), true[take].mean())
    if not pairs:
        return calibration
    train = data['train']
    lab_id = np.asarray(train['lab_id'])
    curves = train['strain_curves_obs'] - train['strain_0'][:, None]
    rates = train['instant_rate_obs']
    measured = np.isfinite(train['coupon_features_raw']).all(axis=1)
    anchor = ~np.isin(lab_id, list(pairs))
    if not anchor.any():
        return calibration
    past, hold = _physical(train, calibration)
    tau, w = _fit((past[anchor], hold[anchor], features[anchor], dt, times), curves[anchor], rates[anchor])
    a, b = _design(tau, past[anchor], hold[anchor], features[anchor], dt, times)
    resid = np.column_stack((a @ w - curves[anchor], b @ w - rates[anchor]))
    scale = np.maximum(1.4826 * np.median(abs(resid - np.median(resid, axis=0)), axis=0), 1e-06)
    calibration = calibration.copy()
    for lab, (xc, yc) in pairs.items():
        use = (lab_id == lab) & measured
        if not use.any():
            continue
        past_cmd = train['past_stress_cmd'][use]
        hold_cmd = train['stress_hold_cmd'][use]
        f = features[use]
        a, b = _design(tau, np.full_like(past_cmd, yc), np.full_like(hold_cmd, yc), f, dt, times)
        offset = np.column_stack((a @ w, b @ w))
        a, b = _design(tau, yc + past_cmd - xc, yc + hold_cmd - xc, f, dt, times)
        signal = np.column_stack((a @ w, b @ w)) - offset
        target = np.column_stack((curves[use], rates[use])) - offset
        gain = least_squares(lambda g: ((g[0] * signal - target) / scale).ravel(), [calibration[lab, 0]], loss='soft_l1').x[0]
        calibration[lab] = (gain, yc - gain * xc)
    return calibration
